description: Source code for the SocketBIOAdapter class, which provides an interface between socket operations and OpenSSL BIOs for TLS connections within the Chromium net stack.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapter
classes.description: Implements a BIO interface for socket communication, facilitating TLS operations.

methods.name: BIORead
methods.description: Reads data from the socket via BIO interface, handling buffering and socket readiness.

methods.name: BIOWrite
methods.description: Writes data to the socket via BIO interface, managing buffering and socket write operations.

methods.name: HandleSocketReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a socket read operation.

methods.name: HandleSocketWriteResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a socket write operation.

methods.name: OnSocketReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a socket read.

methods.name: OnSocketReadIfReadyComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: OnSocketWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a socket write.

methods.name: CallOnReadReady
methods.description: Triggers delegate to indicate socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: GetAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the SocketBIOAdapter instance from a BIO structure.

methods.name: BIOCtrlWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIO control commands.
